reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin 30 Days Miracle Brightening Toner 150ml
reviews.text: I was so excited about this line of skincare, but it was a little drying on my skin. It could be that it isn’t suited for my skin in winter because of the dry air, so I will try it again in the spring.
reviews.zh: 本來對呢個護膚系列好興奮，但用落對我塊面有少少乾。可能係冬天空氣乾燥未必啱我用，所以我會春天再試多次。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin 30 Days Miracle Brightening Toner 150ml
reviews.text:
LoVe <3 TBH I had no expectations but after using daily for 3 weeks I thing I see some changes. Besides the brightening effect it feels great on the skin, doesn't cause irritation, and keeps the skin hydrated.
I have super sensitive skin and i can't use most of the brightening products (especially the ones with vitamin c), and this toner didn't cause me any irritation or harsh reaction.
reviews.zh:
好鍾意 <3 老實講本來冇咩期望，但日日用咗 3 個星期之後，我覺得係見到啲分別。除咗有提亮效果，搽上皮膚感覺好舒服，唔會刺激，又keep到皮膚水潤。
我皮膚超敏感，大部份提亮產品（尤其係有維他命 C 嗰啲）我都用唔到，但呢支爽膚水完全冇刺激到我，又冇咩強烈反應。
